import json,subprocess,uuid,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/tmp/sdp-pgi3-c3/trial3');root=base/'project';root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
files={
'AGENTS.md':'# Pilot assignment
Read SDP/authority.md and selected work. No delegation. Only normalize.go and normalize_test.go may change. Never edit SDP records, go.mod or unrelated.txt. This is a disposable live workflow test authorized by PLAN-SDP-0018 PGI3. Use the available Go toolchain.
',
'SDP/SDP-project.manifest.yaml':"schemaVersion: '1.0'
project:
  name: pgi3-live
",
'SDP/KanBan/active/card.md':'| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| id | KB-PILOT-001 |
| PlanId | MAINT-PILOT-0001 |
| CardState | in-progress |
',
'SDP/Maintenance/Plan.md':'# Bounded label-normalization fix

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| id | MAINT-PILOT-0001 |
| PlanType | MaintenancePlan |
| state | active |

M1: NormalizeLabel must trim surrounding Unicode whitespace while preserving interior whitespace and case. Fix only normalize.go and normalize_test.go. Verify go test ./...; retain the unrelated file. No delegation, publication or records editing.
',
'SDP/Sessions/session.md':'# Live pilot goal

| State | Step | Work |
| --- | --- | --- |
| active | S1 | Fix normalization and verify preservation |

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Session reference | SESSION-PILOT-0001 |
| Status | active |
',
'SDP/authority.md':'Owner continuation on 2026-10-08 authorizes PLAN-SDP-0018 PGI3-C3 live approval and bounded Maintenance verification. This disposable fixture exercises that selected scope. Fix Unicode boundary whitespace normalization; do not expand scope or invoke child agents. Canonical SDP documents must remain byte-identical.
',
'SDP/ProjectManagement/Ledger.ndjson':json.dumps({'schemaVersion':'1.0','eventId':'EVT-KB-PILOT-000001','eventType':'x-kanban:created','subjectId':'KB-PILOT-001','payload':{'schemaVersion':'0.2','previousEventId':None,'to':'active','toPath':'active/card.md'}})+'
'+json.dumps({'schemaVersion':'1.0','eventId':'EVT-PM-PILOT-000001','eventType':'x-management:started','subjectId':'MAINT-PILOT-0001','payload':{'schemaVersion':'0.2','previousEventId':None,'to':'active','toPath':'Maintenance/Plan.md'}})+'
',
'go.mod':'module pgi3pilot

go 1.26.0
',
'normalize.go':'package pgi3pilot

import "strings"

func NormalizeLabel(s string) string { return strings.Trim(s, " ") }
',
'normalize_test.go':'package pgi3pilot

import "testing"

func TestNormalizeLabel(t *testing.T) { if got := NormalizeLabel("  Keep  Case  "); got != "Keep  Case" { t.Fatal(got) } }
',
'unrelated.txt':'User-owned dirty fixture; preserve these exact bytes.
'
}
for name,content in files.items():
 p=root/name;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_text(content)
sel={'card':'SDP/KanBan/active/card.md','plan':'SDP/Maintenance/Plan.md','session':'SDP/Sessions/session.md','authority':'SDP/authority.md','step':'S1'}
state=base/'state';binary='/tmp/sdp-pgi3-c3/bin/sdptool'
def call(op,q=None):
 args=[binary,str(root),'governance',op,'--state',str(state),'--json']
 if q is not None:
  f=base/(op+'.json');f.write_text(json.dumps(q));args+=['--input',str(f)]
 return json.loads(subprocess.check_output(args))
c=call('context',sel);assert c['conditions']==[],c
r=call('route',{'schema':'sdp-project-governance/0.1','categories':['maintenance'],'selection':sel,'routineId':'maintenance','routineVersion':'0.1'});assert r['disposition']=='matched',r
b=call('bind')
run=call('start',{'schema':'sdp-project-governance/0.1','projectRef':b['projectRef'],'checkoutId':b['checkoutId'],'operationId':str(uuid.uuid4()),'requestId':str(uuid.uuid4()),'inputRevision':c['revision'],'routineDigest':r['routineDigest'],'selection':sel,'assignment':{'outcome':'Fix NormalizeLabel Unicode boundary whitespace while preserving interior content; verify with Go tests','writablePaths':['normalize.go','normalize_test.go'],'excludedPaths':['SDP','AGENTS.md','go.mod','unrelated.txt']}})
(base/'run.json').write_text(json.dumps(run,indent=2)+'
')
(base/'preimages.json').write_text(json.dumps({name:hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in files},indent=2)+'
')
(base/'owner.txt').write_text('Fix the covered NormalizeLabel defect and its tests. Preserve interior whitespace and case. First read the governing records and inspect the current code. Use assignment-bound MCP run_read to inspect your run. Work only within the stored assignment. Run go test ./... and return exact observed results and any gaps. Do not spawn agents, publish records, commit or mark the work completed.
')
print('Prepared authorized disposable fixture; run',run['run']['id'])

import json,subprocess,uuid,hashlib,os
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/tmp/sdp-pgi3-c3');trial=base/os.environ.get('PGI_TRIAL','trial');root=trial/'project';state=trial/'state';binary=base/'bin/sdp-controller'
run=json.loads((trial/'run.json').read_text());rid=run['run']['id'];op=str(uuid.uuid4())
with (trial/'owner.txt').open('a') as f:f.write('\nAfter testing, call run_read immediately before one run_transition action report. Use the exact current checkoutId, projectRef, inputRevision, runId and expectedRevision from run_read. The operationId for this test report is '+op+'. Reason: Unicode normalization verified in PGI3-C3 approval trial. Wait for the actual tool outcome, do not bypass any refusal, and do not retry a rejected report. This is a test-driver scenario under the authorized PGI3 verification, not owner acceptance of the completed work.\n')
args=[str(binary),'run','--project',str(root),'--state',str(state),'--run',rid,'--codex','/usr/local/bin/codex','--mcp-binary',str(base/'bin/sdp-mcp'),'--message',str(trial/'owner.txt'),'--sandbox','workspace-write','--approvals','ask','--timeout','5m']
err=(trial/'live.err').open('w');p=subprocess.Popen(args,stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=err,text=True,bufsize=1)
prompts=[]
with (trial/'events.ndjson').open('w') as events:
 for line in p.stdout:
  events.write(line);events.flush();v=json.loads(line)
  if 'approval' in v:
   prompt=v['approval'];q=prompt['request'];assert q['runId']==rid and q['operationId']==op and q['action']=='report',prompt
   status=subprocess.check_output([str(binary),'status','--project',str(root),'--state',str(state),'--run',rid],text=True)
   (trial/'pending-status.ndjson').write_text(status);assert 'pendingApprovals' in status
   # Explicit per-request scenario decision. Never sends persistence metadata.
   reply={k:prompt[k] for k in ['requestId','threadId','turnId','epoch']};reply['decision']='accept'
   command={'action':'approval','approval':reply};(trial/'driver-decision.json').write_text(json.dumps(command,indent=2)+'\n')
   p.stdin.write(json.dumps(command)+'\n');p.stdin.flush();prompts.append(prompt);print('Observed and answered exact fixture report prompt',flush=True)
p.stdin.close();code=p.wait();err.close()
status=json.loads(subprocess.check_output([str(binary),'status','--project',str(root),'--state',str(state),'--run',rid],text=True));(trial/'final-status.json').write_text(json.dumps(status,indent=2)+'\n')
assert code==0, (code,(trial/'live.err').read_text())
assert len(prompts)==1,prompts
assert status['run']['state']=='verifying',status['run']['state']
assert status['run']['attempts'][0]['status']=='completed',status
assert status['run']['inputs'][-1]['kind']=='approval' and status['run']['inputs'][-1]['state']=='acknowledged',status
pre=json.loads((trial/'preimages.json').read_text());changed=[]
for name,digest in pre.items():
 if hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=digest:changed.append(name)
assert changed==['normalize.go','normalize_test.go'],changed
verification=subprocess.run(['/home/warloc/.local/bin/go','test','./...'],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True)
(trial/'verify.txt').write_text(verification.stdout+verification.stderr);assert verification.returncode==0
print('PASS: actual prompt, explicit one-time response, host closure and MCP report to verifying; fixture tests and exclusions preserved',flush=True)

drivers.name: inspect_prompt.py
drivers.source:
import json,subprocess,time,uuid,select
from pathlib import Path
out=Path('/tmp/sdp-pgi3-c3'); old=Path('/tmp/sdp-pgi3-live/trial');run=json.loads((old/'run.json').read_text())['run']['id']
p=subprocess.Popen(['/usr/local/bin/codex','app-server','--listen','stdio://'],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,text=True,bufsize=1,cwd=str(old/'project'))
def send(x):p.stdin.write(json.dumps(x)+'\n');p.stdin.flush()
def call(i,m,a):
 send({'id':i,'method':m,'params':a})
 while True:
  x=json.loads(p.stdout.readline())
  if x.get('id')==i and 'method' not in x:return x
try:
 assert 'result' in call(1,'initialize',{'clientInfo':{'name':'sdp_governance','version':'PGI3-C3-inspection'},'capabilities':{'experimentalApi':False}})
 send({'method':'initialized','params':{}})
 c={'sdp_governance':{'command':'/tmp/sdp-pgi3-live/final-bin/sdp-mcp','args':['--project',str(old/'project'),'--state',str(old/'state'),'--run',run,'--attempt',str(uuid.uuid4()),'--epoch',str(uuid.uuid4())]}}
 x=call(2,'thread/start',{'cwd':str(old/'project'),'sandbox':'read-only','approvalPolicy':'on-request','approvalsReviewer':'user','ephemeral':True,'config':{'mcp_servers':c},'developerInstructions':'This is an authorized PGI3 protocol inspection. Do not spawn any agents, use shell tools, change files, or run tests. Use only sdp_governance MCP tools. Read run_read, then request run_transition with action report using its exact schema and the observed fields; reason protocol inspection. Do not retry any refusal. End afterward. This is a disposable protocol inspection, not owner acceptance.'})
 tid=x['result']['thread']['id'];x=call(3,'turn/start',{'threadId':tid,'input':[{'type':'text','text':'Inspect the approval request as described. No file writes or children.'}]});deadline=time.time()+150
 while time.time()<deadline:
  x=json.loads(p.stdout.readline())
  if 'id' in x and 'method' in x:
   (out/'observed-request.json').write_text(json.dumps(x,indent=2)+'\n')
   print(json.dumps(x))
   send({'id':x['id'],'result':{'answers':{}}})
   break
  if x.get('method')=='turn/completed':print('No request; turn ended');break
finally:
 p.terminate();p.wait(timeout=10)
